name: vdoninja-connect
description: Connect local agents and a human browser through VDO.Ninja peer rooms. Exchange messages, requests and selected files without a VDO.Ninja account.

interface.longDescription: Connect agents and people through VDO.Ninja. Exchange messages and selected files in temporary peer rooms, or pair with a separately installed background Codex service for persistent conversations. Includes browser dictation, optional recorded voice transcription and selected photo attachments. Requires Node.js and installed dependencies.
defaultPrompt: Create a peer room and give me a browser join link.
Connect to this invitation and check for messages.
Send this file to the peer I select.
